## Focused Native phase / parallelism reference handoff

Responding to [6885293536](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/issues/991#issuecomment-6885293536) under the [#903 external-reference convention](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/issues/903).

- **Reference branch:** [reference/external/991-native-phase-cost](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/tree/reference/external/991-native-phase-cost)
- **Exact published reference:** [8b639901c4dbe157dce904acec718a23f580c6ca](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/commit/8b639901c4dbe157dce904acec718a23f580c6ca)
- **Audited/executed base and sole parent:** **3b47cbba770c31eb1487b50f7e3b16533c10e827**, `codex/964-session-owner` / PR #979.
- **Current entrypoint:** [.reference/HANDOFF.md](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/blob/8b639901c4dbe157dce904acec718a23f580c6ca/.reference/HANDOFF.md), leading to [RESULTS.md](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/blob/8b639901c4dbe157dce904acec718a23f580c6ca/.reference/RESULTS.md).
- **Producer:** OpenAI ChatGPT; exposed model GPT-6 Astra Pro; Default mode with parallel source analysis and independent reviews. **Requester:** Riverhog integration agent, relayed by nashspence. **Publisher:** ChatGPT's connected GitHub tools.

This is an **analysis/evidence-only handoff**. Every path outside `.reference/` equals the audited base. The published tree `dbddfd0b217ac4353f2a52d28aa58a314f1ab149` matches the locally reviewed tree; all **33 manifest entries** and the lossless raw-observation archive verified after fetching the published ref. Relevant runtime/helper subtrees are also checked byte-identical to the historical 931f01e publication source. The accepted private-projection helper/test and reader are preserved.

### What the focused work establishes

One actual Native diagnostic used three small maintained-history recipes, fresh retained sessions, ordinary **rows 64 / source 65,536 / work 33,619,968-byte** budgets, and normal exact validation/materialization. It performed no Core/API/archive publication. All **479 retained advances** completed:

| History | Bytes / frames | Session advances | Per-frame replay calls |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Initial, six active assertions | 4,913 / 1 | 107 | 103 |
| Initial + empty checkpoint | 5,903 / 2 | 125 | 103 + 16 |
| Initial + agent-label correction | 6,193 / 2 | 247 | 103 + 138 |

Every call reconciles as source scan + post-frame synchronization + replay calls + two terminal moves. The 64-row quantum applies **within the selected child phase**. Separate admission, walk, reclamation, completion, lifecycle and publication turns explain the fixed granularity. The correction revalidates all six active assertions after replacing one; its 36 correction-specific replay calls include target/aggregate work, reseeding and graph retirement controls. All graph-plan adjacency counts were zero, so these cases do not characterize nontrivial DAG cost.

There are **942 `_start` calls and 942 parent loads** inside the advances: one outer pair per Session call plus one inner pair for each of 463 replay calls, including frame admission. The second budget start resets the reservation; it does not double the charge. `_start` itself issues no SQL. Both captured loads agree on the sampled fields in this successful trace; that does not authorize removing the second observation.

All `_start` calls together used **0.029826 s instrumented thread CPU**, about 1% of retained-advance CPU. Larger disjoint captured categories include ledger controls (**0.944522 s CPU**) and admitted DBAPI execution (**0.815808 s CPU**), across retained setup/advance/materialization/receiving. Those observations favor attributable checkpoint/control and transaction investigation over assuming `_start` dominates. No savings estimate or historical-time extrapolation is made.

Within advances, **4,937 of 9,254 Native execute attempts** are the disjoint ledger-plus-BEGIN selection, consistent with the `9+4h` warm parent-control algebra. Across all retained stages there are 9,524 execute attempts, 12 executescript attempts, 7,789 fetch/iterator attempts and 497 explicit commit **API calls**. Commit calls are not a count of additional durable transactions/fsyncs. No DBAPI exception family was observed; 22 iterator exhaustions are normal completion. These are not the historical Core catalog-attempt counters, and their wall/CPU difference does not isolate database wait.

The checkpoint/correction source windows returned **990 / 1,280 extra suffix bytes** because one-frame framing stops before the end of a returned window. Direct JSON-atom admission reads are separate; nested window→exact delivery is counted once. This is bounded lookahead, not evidence of repeated accepted-prefix hashing. Correction-wide effective-projection revalidation remains a distinct total-work concern; no whole-path growth closure follows from these tiny cases.

### Historical cost and parallelism remain properly bounded

The 9,843 historical Native calls split into **4,176 publication + 5,667 exhaustive verification**. Each verification pass performs physical-journal validation and independent shared/member closures; warm ciphertext bytes do not remove fresh semantic obligations. Native/Core inclusive timings overlap and are not summed.

The **418 historical raised catalog attempts remain unclassified**. The publication comment says error families were not captured; the supplied material does not provide driver-code/site/disposition attribution, and the exact extended recorder/raw receipt was unavailable. Known contention-handling code establishes a possible path, not the cause of those attempts.

Journal concurrency 2 is a retained-slot limit, not a two-thread executor. Same-journal phases remain serial; different exact ready keys can proceed under distinct grants/callers. The historical evidence lacks simultaneous ready-key/admission/start/receive intervals, so it cannot establish missed parallelism from 428 hook-observed worker lifetimes.

The local seal path has a direct scheduler opportunity followed by the HTTP selected-journal opportunity. The SDK repeats journal seals without the 50 ms sleep; that delay belongs to finalization/custody polling. Unentered TestClient requests create a source-supported portal/worker turnover mechanism. Merely entering TestClient would also start application lifespan and background maintenance, changing scheduling conditions; it is not a neutral transport control.

### Receiving and next focused step

The actual timed lane finished in **13.399518 s**, below the **120 s cooperative** workload cap. Original probe/lane/launcher exits were **0**; 71 hooks were restored, all 20 original construction/oracle handles were received, all retained admission counters/frames were zero, and both scratch levels were removed. Construction/oracle Native work is separate from the 479-counter scope. A preceding uv-version-format preflight exited **1 before any Native work**; its original script/log/receipts remain archived. The sole retry change accepted the pinned executable's platform suffix. Pinned Ruff/syntax and independent receipt/source/phase reviews passed.

**First focused receiving step:** verify the manifest/source relationship and inspect [the phase reconciliation](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/blob/8b639901c4dbe157dce904acec718a23f580c6ca/.reference/RECONCILIATION.md) and [disjoint cost tables](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/blob/8b639901c4dbe157dce904acec718a23f580c6ca/.reference/COSTS.md). Select one source-owned investigation into checkpoint serialization or warm Core control/query construction, preserving fresh source/worker/certificate checks and original receiving. Classify catalog raises and establish ready-key occupancy before attributing waste or proposing concurrency changes. Phase consolidation would need separate interruption/error-order/resource/growth evidence.

No runtime patch, new archive publication, caller census, broad suite, large campaign, CI qualification or timing gate is supplied. G10/G12/G13, observer cost, publication cost and parallelism stay open under #964/#991. This packet does not repeat the adopted helper timing pair or call 67b4 fully qualified. It is non-authoritative input for normal receiving; scope, acceptance and integration remain with the owning issue and Riverhog's normal rail. No Development association or issue-closing action is requested.

Received [Native phase handoff 6887181395](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/issues/991#issuecomment-6887181395), reference **8b639901c4dbe157dce904acec718a23f580c6ca**. All 33 manifest entries, sole-parent/evidence-only relationship to fully qualified 3b47cbba7, current helper/reader pins and historical runtime equality verified. The lossless raw hash verified; receiving-owner offline reconciliation matched every guard and all 479 advances without product execution.

The tiny histories reconcile to 107 / 125 / 247 advances. Separate admission, cleanup, completion and publication phases explain much of the count. Repeated budget-start work was about 1% of measured advance CPU; checkpoint controls, database calls and explicit commit scopes were larger costs. Correction revalidated all six effective assertions after one replacement; that aggregate-work concern remains distinct. Zero graph adjacency visits do not qualify nontrivial DAG growth. The historical 418 raised Core catalog attempts and actual ready-key/worker occupancy remain unclassified/unmeasured. Retained slots are not a thread executor.

### Received codec refinement and integration

One bounded codec refinement on clean 3b47cbba7 completed 479 retained advances with exact ordinary oracles, all original resources received, 77 hooks restored and scratch removed. Its whole maintained lane was 7.423 s. This differently instrumented/conditioned observation is not compared with the producer's 13.400 s or product throughput.

It recorded 5,185 prefix decodes, including two same-length/same-hash inputs within each of 945 load, 479 fence and 479 publication observations. The 1,424 load/fence pairs identified repeated decoding within one fresh observation; three initialization repeats are additional.

Pushed **d4d7b6535be2cf491b7859cacea2a9ada4ac8d9e** in PR #979. The private prefix reader now returns its exact fresh row plus the parsed state used to check it. Initialization/read/fence consume that state within the same invocation. Publication still independently parses its selected prefix. Every fresh SQL read, source/worker/algorithm/prefix/predecessor predicate, canonical codec, transaction and compare-and-set remains; no cross-call decoded state or acceptance cache was added.

Pinned lint and **107 focused Native owner cases** passed, including nine new warm-corruption cases and **nine growth witnesses / nine executions / 130 samples**. Stale/corrupt state, rollback, durable process interruption/restart, cold/wide checkpoints and retained Session/EntryReplay behavior were included. Original worker/make exits and cleanup received.

A second finite diagnostic used the exact archived initial/checkpoint/correction bytes. All 479 semantic progress/control traces, noncodec method counts, DBAPI attempts, source deliveries and materialized outcomes matched. Prefix decodes fell **5,185 → 3,758**; all 1,903 ValidationCheckpoint parses remained. This is work-count evidence, not a throughput comparison; diagnostic construction and hook costs prevent comparing whole-lane timings.

Current [CI 43664490758](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/actions/runs/43664490758), tested merge **05abffaef7f87a93b4949fcd6981e4ce6d033864**, is running for 7,579 selected supplemental cases, all 26 workloads and **48 growth witnesses / 54 executions**. All previous case IDs remain; nine cases are new source tests and 69 existing owner cases expand supplemental receiving. Predecessor 3b47cbba7 remains fully qualified.

### Focused design/reference request: bounded Core stepping

Audited receiving checkpoint is publicly available: **d4d7b6535be2cf491b7859cacea2a9ada4ac8d9e**. Reconcile its narrow prefix-decoding change first; full CI is pending.

Investigate whether one explicitly bounded Core journal-owner unit can drive several existing Native advances, preserving Native phases, per-phase durable commits and fresh per-step authority checks, then adopt catalog progress at the correct boundary. The purpose is to reduce repeated outer stamps/prerequisite/control coordination. This is a design question, not a prescribed patch or permission to loop under unchanged accounting.

Please provide a non-authoritative source-owned design/reference that:
- Defines explicit per-unit step/work/resource admission and every actual child multiplicity. Preserve bounded coordination, fairness, independent growth obligations and total/inclusive composition; no hidden extra work or archive-size cap.
- Explains Native progress committed before catalog adoption, stale source/worker/certificate replacement, capacity pauses, partial failure, cancellation, reply loss, durable restart, other ready journals, retained readers and original receiving. Identify checks that remain fresh at each inner step and final adoption.
- Keeps the existing Native state machine and durable transactions as the initial scope. Phase fusion, removed commits or changed concurrency require a separately justified design/authority discussion.
- Evaluates growth first, including repeated whole-resource preparation and distinct correction-wide work. Do not label all remaining cost constant or claim G10/G12/G13 closure.
- Uses static/retained evidence first and only a few tiny actual Core/Native turns if needed, under an approximately two-minute finite cap. Preserve exact results, every child/primitive observation, original exits and cleanup. No publication campaign, full census, broad suite or 1,000+ run.
- Recommends leaving the change out if invariant/resource/error-order proof does not support it, and identifies any required owning design decision.

Native transaction cost, catalog-raise classification, transport/lifespan cost and parallelism occupancy remain tracked here. Whole-path #964 acceptance remains open. Full census repetition and aggressive 1,000/10,000/100,000 campaigns stay held; no timing gate, merge, release or provider activation is added.

Received the [bounded-Core-stepping handoff 6889755494](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/issues/991#issuecomment-6889755494), exact reference 46ace062078d08cd70f508a3f3a7d834a92cbb40 on sole parent d4d7b6535be2cf491b7859cacea2a9ada4ac8d9e. All 13 manifest entries, 47 distinct tracked source pins, 12 subtree relationships, the exact two-file prefix delta and both context comments reconciled. Product paths outside the reference packet are identical; receiving ran no product calls or tests.

Decision: retain the current one-step runtime and per-step catalog adoption. Static source review confirms that ordinary Native certificate checks do not cover the completed rank graph-result predicate. Final-only adoption also needs a different partial-progress protocol when an earlier Native commit is followed by capacity or a later catalog conflict. The conservative alternative preserves those checks but establishes only possible intermediate stamp savings while changing scheduler/finalization opportunities; that does not presently justify a new coordination boundary. A fresh preparation-readiness validator remains separate owning research if pursued.

Current d4d7 source remains fully qualified. This closes the immediate grouping proposal, not #991, #964 or G10/G12/G13 acceptance.

Next independent analysis is one tiny F1/C1/K2/Q1 publication diagnostic: one 65,536-byte member, ordinary retained journals, a 120-second finalization deadline and a finite 4 GiB scratch-disk lease. It extends the existing recorder with bounded exception type/database-code, parameter-free SQL structure identity, owning scope and failed-attempt interval records. Meaningful actual-SQL self-checks must preserve missing-column and nonwaiting writer-refusal errors before the profile can run. Fresh/warm/evicted reader verification and original helper/scratch receiving remain required.

This addresses the missing catalog-error details; transport/transaction cost, correction-wide work and actual ready-key/worker occupancy remain open. The full caller census and aggressive member-scale campaigns stay held. No product runtime change, CI rerun, throughput claim, merge, release or provider activation.

## Received occupancy reference and bounded Native cost accounting

Received [handoff 6890287748](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/issues/991#issuecomment-6890287748), exact reference bcb8de725c1958e685fbc4afc417f32bedaece13 on sole parent d4d7b6535be2cf491b7859cacea2a9ada4ac8d9e. All 12 manifest entries, 72 tracked source pins, nine subtree relationships, four installed dependency implementation pins and three context comments reconciled. Product paths are unchanged. This is static evidence: ordinary Core journal work runs synchronously on its caller and has no submission queue or worker pool. Two retained journal slots establish custody, not unused execution capacity. Deployment-level ready-work/worker occupancy remains unknown. No fixture was run merely to restate that negative result.

One small Native-only function-CPU diagnostic completed using the same exact initial/checkpoint/correction journal bytes and ordinary output oracles. All 479 retained advances reconciled with the prior lane's semantic/control traces, DBAPI inventories and source deliveries; fresh per-execution child identities were bijectively normalized rather than comparing their dependent checkpoint hashes across runs. All 77 diagnostic hooks were retained and restored. Original exits and scratch receiving passed. Complete helper elapsed time was 23.491 seconds; this is an instrumented observation, not a throughput comparison.

Within its three retained-advance stages, wall time was 18.949 seconds and thread CPU was 10.367 seconds. The existing disjoint dbapi.commit scopes recorded **482 actual commit API calls: 8.713 seconds wall / 0.132 seconds thread CPU**. Their wall/CPU gap accounts for most of the enclosing recorded gap. This scope includes owning admission and driver work; it does **not** isolate fsync, storage contention or lock waiting, prove all commits are avoidable, or establish a regression. Method/codec recorder overhead is also material.

A second, deliberately smaller-observer diagnostic removed those method/codec/source/DBAPI hooks and retained only returned-progress observation plus function CPU profiling. It reached its predeclared 120-second cooperative work deadline after 440/479 advances. Initial and checkpoint cases completed with their normal materialization oracles; correction stopped after 208/247 returned advances. Every returned control matches the corresponding prior prefix, excluding only per-execution checkpoint hashes. All originals, resources and scratch were received. This is **partial evidence**, not a completed three-history lane, and will not be automatically repeated.

The two complete reduced-observer cases contain 232 advances and 2.741 seconds of profiler-accounted exclusive thread CPU. They include 5,562 canonical JSON encoding calls (0.581 seconds inclusive at that function boundary) and 405 SHA-256 compression calls (0.440 seconds inclusive at that separate boundary). Canonical checkpoint/continuation validation, hashing, SQLite execution and fixed phase multiplicity remain concrete cost categories; inclusive ancestor times must not be added. These tiny inputs do not establish that remaining cost is independent of growth.

Source d4d7 remains fully CI-qualified; there is no pending CI or product patch. The incomplete full small-journal caller census, whole-path G10/G12/G13 acceptance and 1,000/10,000/100,000 campaigns remain held.

## Focused design/reference request: Native transition and commit granularity

The next substantive question is whether the current Native transition/commit multiplicity contains safely avoidable work. Please provide a **narrow source/design reference on d4d7**, with one best actionable candidate or a specific counterexample explaining why it requires a separate owning protocol change.

Use the already received [Native phase reference](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/issues/991#issuecomment-6887181395), exact reference 8b639901c4dbe157dce904acec718a23f580c6ca, for its lossless three-history control inventory; account explicitly for d4d7's two-file prefix-decode delta. The initial/checkpoint/correction retained counts are 107/125/247; SemanticFinish has 25 prepares for six assertions in that packet. Those are measured invocation counts, not proof that any phase or durability boundary can be removed.

Determine which bookkeeping or semantic phase boundaries may legally share a bounded owning unit and which must remain separately committed/observed. Address aggregate row/octet/phase admission, fresh source/worker/prefix/predecessor and preparation dependency authority, transaction/CAS, partial progress followed by capacity or error, terminal/result receiving, interruption/restart and original cleanup. Preserve whole-path growth composition: fewer public calls cannot conceal repeated whole-resource work or silently invalidate existing single-child declarations.

Do not bypass the [retained one-step Core decision](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/issues/991#issuecomment-6889902338) by moving a loop inside Native. Explicitly check that decision's missing rank-result/readiness counterexample and any required Core observation between proposed transitions. No implementation, commit removal, weaker durability, stale acceptance cache, changed concurrency, provider work or broad campaign is authorized by this request. If the opportunity instead requires a new readiness/transaction protocol, name the exact missing owning contract and stop there.

Static analysis is preferred. No full publication or completion/caller census is needed. Any essential runtime illustration must justify a genuinely tiny finite fixture and receiving envelope first, use an approximately 120-second cooperative workload cap with original cleanup, and retain partial outcomes without retrying to manufacture completion.
